war_summary: War 139 is on day 98 with no winner yet. The Colonials hold a significant strategic advantage, controlling 169 bases to the Wardens' 67 across 40 regions, with 1 neutral base in Clahstra. However, the most intense combat is concentrated in a few contested regions. Callahans Passage and Endless Shore are experiencing massive, accelerating casualties (thousands per hour) with high enlistment surges, indicating major ongoing offensives. Clahstra, Oarbreaker, Stlican Shelf, Marban Hollow, Mooring County, and Olavis Wake also show high, accelerating casualty rates and active base flipping. Conversely, large swaths of the map (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are Colonial-held but quiet, suggesting consolidated rear areas. The Wardens hold several quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Speaking Woods, Reaching Trail) but are suffering heavy casualties in Speaking Woods, indicating pressure there.
